story.head: Leevi Meriläinen is in for some dangerous shots
paras: The Capitals (11-12-0) lost 3-2 to Florida on Friday, and the Canucks are on a three-game losing streak. Going in, the Canucks are last in the NHL and the Capitals sixth in the Metropolitan (tied for 27th in the NHL).

The Canucks haven’t played well, but their record (.232) is worse than their play: their chances are worth about .343, and their goaltending has held them back. The Capitals have played better than their record (.478) says: their chances are worth about .578, and losses in one-goal games have held them back.

The Canucks pick their shots (lowest), have had shaky goaltending (32nd) and have a leaky penalty kill (32nd). Vancouver has allowed 4.43 goals a game, the most in the league. The Capitals get their shots through to the net (5th), but give up a lot of dangerous shots (28th). They also get some of the league’s best looks (2nd), so the Capitals could find some good looks against the Canucks, who give up plenty of them. Washington has allowed 3.87 goals a game, the second most in the league. The Canucks hit a lot, but the Caps mostly don’t.

Brock Boeser (8 G / 20 A / 28 P in 28 GP) leads the Canucks in scoring, and Jake DeBrusk (9 G / 6 A / 15 P in 26 GP) has a team-high nine goals. Alex Tuch (15 G / 5 A / 20 P in 23 GP) is tied for the Capitals’ scoring lead, with seven points in his last five games. Ryan Leonard (10 G / 10 A / 20 P in 23 GP) shares it.
Leevi Meriläinen (4-12-1 / .883 SV% in 18 GS) will likely start for Vancouver, and Logan Thompson (8-7-0 / .880 SV% in 17 GS) for Washington.
The Capitals usually control more of the chances than the Canucks do.

items.text: The Canucks are newly without Filip Chytil, have been without Elias Pettersson (#40) since Nov 19, and have had to make do without Thatcher Demko all season. Leevi Meriläinen is expected to start.
The Capitals are newly without Jordan Kyrou, and have been without Rasmus Sandin for several games.
Alex Ovechkin has one goal on chances worth about 5.7 goals, well below what his finishing usually turns chances into. If the chances keep coming, so should the goals.
Ryan Leonard has a point in seven straight games.
